name: feature-bento
title: Feature Bento Grid
blurb: Asymmetric 3-column bento grid of feature and stat cards.
description: A responsive bento layout showcasing an enlarged hero card, statistics, feature highlights, and CTA cards with gradient backgrounds and hover scale effects.
use_when: Feature landing pages or product showcases where visual hierarchy and card variety create visual interest.
avoid_when: Content-dense layouts where mixed card sizes and hover effects could create usability friction.
a11y: Decorative background images; text hierarchy is semantic. Hover effects are visual only; functionality is not gesture-dependent.
